periods.label: 深海魔女的强敌预告
titles: 破军学园一年一班B级骑士

status.selection_battle_record: continues undefeated; next official opponent is Toka Todo

personality.summary: Devoted to Ikki, sharp-tongued toward Stella, and more mature in love than her teasing suggests; in combat she shows cold destructive intensity.
desires: fight opponents strong enough to force full effort

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother; she supports his happiness even while teasing Stella.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Bickering romantic rival; she nonetheless acknowledges Stella if Stella can make Ikki happy.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Close friend and usual training companion.
relationships.toka-todo: Upcoming opponent and Hagun's strongest student.

periods.summary: Shizuku watches Ikki defeat Renren and explains that his struggle against Kirihara was not because the enemy was simply unseen. She spars verbally with Stella over Ikki and gives a surprisingly mature account of wanting Ikki's happiness. In the epilogue she trains alone, freezes roughly fifty students in a free-for-all without moving from the center, and smiles at the news that her next opponent is Hagun's strongest student, Toka Todo.

key_events.summary: Explains why Renren's speed is insufficient against Ikki's sword range.
Freezes a mass challenge and receives Toka Todo as next opponent.
